preprocessing.description: Use the native ADM1 shapeISO values only as stable macro IDs and retain original geoBoundaries ADM1 shapeID/name. For each original ADM2 shapeID, require exactly one positive-area ADM1 intersection and exactly zero outside area. Require every parent to equal the dissolve of its member ADM2 polygons by two directional zero-area differences. Never use old Natural Earth ADM1 boundaries, majority overlap, nearest centers, new coordinates or guessed administrative codes. No source geometry is changed.

limits: This is an exact geometry-backed parent crosswalk for the pinned source distribution, not a certification of 2020 administrative legal status.
The parent outlines for gameplay should be derived from these member fine units, with fixed country envelopes/coasts and source-free residuals handled explicitly by the coordinator.
